summary.text: Dawn White is a Republican state senator from Murfreesboro who represents Tennessee Senate District 13 in part of Rutherford County and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A former teacher and small business owner, she chairs the Senate Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Dawn White was born on October 22, 1975, and attended Rutherford County Schools and Riverdale High School, graduating in 1994, according to the Tennessee General Assembly.
She earned a B.S., a Master of Education and a Specialist in Education from Middle Tennessee State University between 1998 and 2002.
Her legislative biography describes her as a former teacher and small business owner, and Ballotpedia lists her as a teacher and Internet retailer.
White served in the Tennessee House of Representatives from the 108th through 110th General Assemblies and has been a member of the Senate since the 111th General Assembly.
Ballotpedia lists her prior office as House District 37, from 2012 to 2018.
She chairs the Senate Education Committee and is a member of the Senate Judiciary Committee.
She sits on the board of the Tennessee State Museum Foundation and CASA of Rutherford County.
